bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 守住 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Microsoft slipped 0.2% on Oct 27 to $531.33, trading between $528.33 and $534.70. It is above the falling 5-day ($528.5) and level with the falling 10-day ($531.0) averages, and above the rising 30-day ($519.8), 100-day ($462.0) and 200-day ($437.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but is above zero, with the histogram narrow; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($544.17), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: 微软 10月27日小跌 0.2%，收于 $531.33，盘中区间 $528.33–534.70。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$528.5）上方，与下行的 10 日均线（$531.0）持平，并位于上行的 30 日（$519.8）、100 日（$462.0）和 200 日均线（$437.1）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图窄幅；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$544.17），RSI 为 56。

read.en: No level changed: the close held the 5 and 10-day, and the $534.7 high stopped below the $535.6 Oct 19 high. Resistance is $534.7–535.6, then $543.8–544.2 (Oct 16 high, SAR) and $551–554. Support is $528.3–531 (5 and 10-day), then $515.7–519.8 (Oct 23 low, 30-day) and $497–502. A close above $535.6 would target $544; a close below $515.7 would open $497–502.
